in_general: Two fire signs: big energy, big fun and zero tolerance for boring weekends.
in_dating: Expect fast chemistry and faster plans. Best dates: something active or spontaneous. Watch out for competing for the spotlight.

in_general: Two earth signs: steady, loyal and practical in the best way.
in_dating: Dating feels calm and real from the start. Best dates: a great meal or a slow weekend morning. Add surprises so steady never turns into stuck.

in_general: Two air signs: you make each other lighter and the conversation never ends.
in_dating: The talking stage will be easy. Best dates: somewhere you can talk for hours. Make sure feelings get airtime, not just ideas.

in_general: Two water signs: deep feeling, strong intuition and a lot said without words.
in_dating: Dating feels intense and safe at once. Best dates: quiet, close and a little romantic. Protect each other's moods.

in_general: Air fans fire: one brings the ideas, the other brings the action.
in_dating: Expect adventures and late nights. Best dates: a new place or a last minute plan. Fire keeps it exciting, air keeps it light.

in_general: Water nourishes earth: one feels, one steadies, and both grow.
in_dating: Dating feels grounded and tender. Best dates: cooking together or a cozy spot. Earth gives safety, water gives depth.

in_general: Fire and earth: one wants to go now, the other wants a plan.
in_dating: Plan the adventure together. Best dates: something bold, booked in advance. Fire lights it, earth makes it happen.

in_general: Fire and water make steam: gorgeous, loud and full of feeling.
in_dating: Chemistry is strong and so are reactions. Best dates: something with passion, like live music. Say things gently and the steam stays warm.

in_general: Air and earth: ideas meet reality. One dreams, the other builds.
in_dating: Dates mix big talk and real plans. Best dates: a museum, then dinner. Respect both styles and you get more done than most couples.

in_general: Air and water: head meets heart. You see the world very differently.
in_dating: Talk about feelings, not just thoughts. Best dates: a long walk with real conversation. Water needs to feel it, air needs to say it.
